items.title: Joint operation conducted by Insurance Authority and Hong Kong Police Force against suspected fraudulent practices of examination centre
items.grounded_note: IA announced a joint enforcement operation with the Hong Kong Police Force on 27 Aug 2026 targeting an examination centre suspected of facilitating fraudulent practices related to the FLMI qualification; IA said it has suspended recognition of FLMI for licensing education requirements and will review affected licence applications.

items.title: HKMA — First cohort of GenA.I. Sandbox++ announced
items.grounded_note: HKMA announced the first cohort of its GenA.I. Sandbox++ on 27 Aug 2026; the release describes participation, objectives and links HKMA work with other regulators and industry on agentic A.I. in financial services.
